rules.indices: int32 little-endian, the main index list as stored
rules.positions: float32 little-endian x, y, z per vertex; fl32((q * scale) / 32767) evaluated in binary64
rules.normals: float32 little-endian x, y, z per vertex; each channel fl32((2v - 1023) / 1023) in binary64
rules.tangents: float32 little-endian x, y, z, w per vertex; channels as normals, w = glTF handedness = -1 for code 3, +1 for code 0 (the stored sign negated: the stored bitangent sign puts cross(N, T) x w along +dP/dv of the raw DirectX UVs, glTF's bitangent runs along -dP/dv)
rules.uv0: float32 little-endian u, v per vertex; the half value exactly, a non-finite component read as +0
rules.uv1: as uv0, for the second set
rules.starfield.uv0.raw: uint16 little-endian u, v half bits per vertex (present only when a UV0 component is not finite)
rules.starfield.uv1.raw: as starfield.uv0.raw, for the second set
rules.starfield.color: uint8 R, G, B, A per vertex (the stored B, G, R, A relaid)
rules.starfield.bone.k: uint16 little-endian bone index of slot k per vertex, as stored
rules.starfield.weight.k: uint16 little-endian weight of slot k per vertex, as stored
rules.lod.k: int32 little-endian, LOD index list k (1-based) as stored
rules.meshlets: uint32 little-endian vertexCount, vertexOffset, triangleCount, triangleOffset per record; present whenever the tail is (a tail with no records digests as the SHA-256 of no bytes)
rules.cull: float32 bits little-endian, center xyz then extent xyz per record; present whenever the tail is
